description: A script for incremental documentation generation based on changed files, handling validation, processing plugins, generating markdown docs from headers and JSON outputs, postprocessing markdown, and updating the sidebar.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path
methods.description: Extracts plugin name from a given file path based on directory structure.

methods.name: validate_json_changes
methods.description: Checks if JSON changes in 'apis/' have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/'.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process
methods.description: Determines which plugins need documentation regeneration based on changed files.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin
methods.description: Generates documentation for a specific plugin from headers and/or JSON output files.

methods.name: postprocess_md
methods.description: Postprocesses generated markdown files to clean up specific markup.

methods.name: update_sidebar
methods.description: Updates the documentation sidebar by running an external script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the incremental documentation generation workflow.
